description: Apply in Cloudflare dashboard → Security → WAF → Custom rules for zone creativephotography.group. Expressions use contains/eq only (no matches/regex — Free/Pro). Block at the edge so scrapers never reach origin.

verification.ip: After the rule is live, Cloudflare Security Events should show action=block for 92.254.97.120.
verification.ua: Requests with User-Agent containing SM-G892A and NRD90M should be blocked at the edge (Chrome version may vary).

rules.name: Block NL scraper IP 92.254.97.120
notes: Observed 2026-08-28: ~70k HTML requests in 24h across many paths.
Origin proxy also blocks this IP; the WAF rule stops it before Vercel.

rules.name: Block Galaxy S8 Active NRD90M scraper fingerprint
notes: Survives Chrome version rotation (e.g. Chrome/109 vs Chrome/60 in copy-paste lists).

CI health wait uses curl, which this rule otherwise blocks. Skip only /api/health; keep path traps and scanner UAs on every other path.
CI also sends User-Agent CPG-CI/1.0 so the poll is not labeled curl if the skip is missing.
